set_G_genmorph.reason: GenMorph (Zenodo 10067096) does not ship a portable, fixed MR catalogue. Its MRs are evolved per-SUT by a genetic-programming search whose fitness is PIT mutation kill, requiring the full GenMorph toolchain (GAssert + Randoop + pitest-wrapper-1.7.4) and a multi-minute GP budget per new SUT. Published evolved MRs exist ONLY for the two pilot SUTs (MathClass?gcd?0, MathClass?sin?0). Re-evolving Set G for the 34 new commons-math methods would require re-running GenMorph's gen mode per SUT; the S7 README documents two structural failure modes that block this at scale: (1) a race on the shared target/classes/<SUT>.class file during Major/PIT compilation, and (2) degenerate GP grammar for boolean-predicate output SUTs. We therefore do NOT fabricate Set G numbers for the new SUTs.

real_data_points_reused_from_pilot.note: These two are REAL GenMorph-evolved Set G results from the existing S5 pilot (PIT 1.7.4, GenMorph Randoop seed-11 input distribution). They are NOT pooled with the n30 Set N/B/M numbers because the n30 runs use PIT 1.15.3 and a different (deterministic, boundary-seeded) input distribution; pooling across tools/distributions would be invalid. Reported here as an honest, separate Set G anchor.
